Hardware Lab IMS user-form code
On Windows Excel, import the matching .frm file instead of pasting,
unless the import is blocked. Import steps are in docs/WINDOWS_EXCEL_SETUP.md.

==============================================================================
frmAuth.frm
VBA editor: File > Import File, and choose this .frm.
==============================================================================
Option Explicit

Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()
    Me.Caption = "Hardware Lab IMS - Sign in"
    lblTitle.Font.Bold = True
    lblTitle.Font.Size = 16
    txtAccessCode.PasswordChar = "*"
    txtEmpID.MaxLength = 32
    txtAccessCode.MaxLength = 32
    btnFillSuper.Visible = IMS_SHOW_DEMO_FILL
    btnFillAdmin.Visible = IMS_SHOW_DEMO_FILL
    btnFillUser.Visible = IMS_SHOW_DEMO_FILL
    lblMessage.Caption = ""
End Sub

Private Sub UserForm_Activate()
    On Error Resume Next
    txtEmpID.SetFocus
End Sub

Private Sub btnLogin_Click()
    If IMS_TryLogin(txtEmpID.Text, txtAccessCode.Text) Then
        Me.Hide
    Else
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnRegister_Click()
    frmRegister.Show
End Sub

Private Sub btnFillSuper_Click()
    txtEmpID.Text = "SA001"
    txtAccessCode.Text = "1001"
    lblMessage.Caption = ""
End Sub

Private Sub btnFillAdmin_Click()
    txtEmpID.Text = "AD010"
    txtAccessCode.Text = "2001"
    lblMessage.Caption = ""
End Sub

Private Sub btnFillUser_Click()
    txtEmpID.Text = "EN1042"
    txtAccessCode.Text = "3001"
    lblMessage.Caption = ""
End Sub

Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)
    If CloseMode = vbFormControlMenu Then
        IMS_SignOut
        Me.Hide
        Cancel = True
    End If
End Sub

==============================================================================
frmDashboard.frm
VBA editor: File > Import File, and choose this .frm.
==============================================================================
Option Explicit

Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()
    lblWho.Font.Bold = True
    IMS_FillCombo cboOwnership, IMS_OwnershipList(), True
    IMS_FillCombo cboStatus, IMS_StatusList(), True
    IMS_FillCombo cboType, IMS_AssetTypeList(), True
    lstAssets.ColumnCount = 8
    lstAssets.ColumnWidths = "110 pt;115 pt;100 pt;90 pt;100 pt;130 pt;80 pt;140 pt"
    btnInward.Visible = IMS_IsCustodianRole(gRole)
    btnTransfer.Visible = IMS_IsCustodianRole(gRole)
    btnUsers.Visible = IMS_IsSuperRole(gRole)
    btnReset.Visible = IMS_IsSuperRole(gRole)
    btnExportAudit.Visible = IMS_IsCustodianRole(gRole)
    If gRole = "User" Then
        lblWho.Caption = gEmpName & "  (" & gEmpID & ")  Engineer view - your assigned assets only"
    ElseIf gRole = "Lead Admin" Then
        lblWho.Caption = gEmpName & "  (" & gEmpID & ")  Lead view - your team's assets only"
    Else
        lblWho.Caption = gEmpName & "  (" & gEmpID & ")  " & gRole
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub UserForm_Activate()
    LoadAssets
End Sub

Private Sub btnRefresh_Click()
    LoadAssets
End Sub

Private Sub cboOwnership_Change()
    LoadAssets
End Sub

Private Sub cboStatus_Change()
    LoadAssets
End Sub

Private Sub cboType_Change()
    LoadAssets
End Sub

Private Sub txtSearch_AfterUpdate()
    LoadAssets
End Sub

Private Sub btnInward_Click()
    frmInward.Show
End Sub

Private Sub btnTransfer_Click()
    frmTransfer.Show
End Sub

Private Sub btnUsers_Click()
    frmUserAdmin.Show
End Sub

Private Sub btnSignOut_Click()
    IMS_SignOut
    Me.Hide
End Sub

Private Sub btnReset_Click()
    IMS_ResetBackend
    LoadAssets
End Sub

Private Sub btnExport_Click()
    Dim data As Variant
    Dim path As Variant
    data = CurrentRows()
    path = IMS_SuggestExportPath("LabInventory")
    If VarType(path) = vbBoolean Then Exit Sub
    On Error GoTo Fail
    IMS_WriteCsv CStr(path), IMS_AssetHeaders(), data
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Inventory snapshot written to " & CStr(path), False
    Exit Sub
Fail:
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, Err.Description, True
End Sub

Private Sub btnExportAudit_Click()
    Dim assets As Variant
    Dim auditRows As Variant
    Dim filtered As Variant
    Dim path As Variant
    Dim wanted As Object
    Dim r As Long
    Dim kept As Long
    Dim i As Long
    assets = CurrentRows()
    auditRows = IMS_QueryAudit()
    If gLastError <> "" And IsEmpty(auditRows) Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set wanted = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    wanted.CompareMode = 1
    If IsArray(assets) Then
        For r = 1 To UBound(assets, 1)
            wanted(CStr(assets(r, 1))) = True
        Next r
    End If
    If Not IsArray(auditRows) Then
        filtered = Empty
    Else
        kept = 0
        For r = 1 To UBound(auditRows, 1)
            If wanted.Exists(CStr(auditRows(r, 3))) Then kept = kept + 1
        Next r
        If kept = 0 Then
            filtered = Empty
        Else
            ReDim filtered(1 To kept, 1 To 7)
            i = 0
            For r = 1 To UBound(auditRows, 1)
                If wanted.Exists(CStr(auditRows(r, 3))) Then
                    i = i + 1
                    Dim c As Long
                    For c = 1 To 7
                        filtered(i, c) = auditRows(r, c)
                    Next c
                End If
            Next r
        End If
    End If
    path = IMS_SuggestExportPath("LabAudit")
    If VarType(path) = vbBoolean Then Exit Sub
    On Error GoTo Fail
    IMS_WriteCsv CStr(path), IMS_AuditHeaders(), filtered
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Audit snapshot for the assets on screen written to " & CStr(path), False
    Exit Sub
Fail:
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, Err.Description, True
End Sub

Private Sub LoadAssets()
    Dim data As Variant
    Dim r As Long
    Dim c As Long
    On Error GoTo Fail
    data = CurrentRows()
    lstAssets.Clear
    lstAssets.ColumnCount = 8
    If Not IsArray(data) Then
        lblCount.Caption = "0 assets"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    For r = 1 To UBound(data, 1)
        lstAssets.AddItem CStr(data(r, 1))
        For c = 2 To 8
            lstAssets.List(lstAssets.ListCount - 1, c - 1) = CStr(data(r, c))
        Next c
    Next r
    lblCount.Caption = CStr(UBound(data, 1)) & " assets"
    Exit Sub
Fail:
    lblCount.Caption = "0 assets"
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, Err.Description, True
End Sub

Private Function CurrentRows() As Variant
    CurrentRows = IMS_QueryAssets(cboOwnership.Value, cboStatus.Value, cboType.Value, txtSearch.Text, "")
End Function

Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)
    If CloseMode = vbFormControlMenu Then
        IMS_SignOut
        Me.Hide
        Cancel = True
    End If
End Sub

==============================================================================
frmInward.frm
VBA editor: File > Import File, and choose this .frm.
==============================================================================
Option Explicit

Private mExisting As Boolean

Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()
    If Not IMS_IsCustodianRole(gRole) Then
        MsgBox "Only inventory custodians can inward hardware.", vbExclamation, IMS_APP_NAME
        Unload Me
        Exit Sub
    End If
    lblTitle.Font.Bold = True
    lblTitle.Font.Size = 16
    IMS_FillCombo cboAssetType, IMS_AssetTypeList(), False
    txtBarcode.MaxLength = 64
    txtInitialAssignee.MaxLength = 32
    ClearForm
End Sub

Private Sub UserForm_Activate()
    On Error Resume Next
    txtBarcode.SetFocus
End Sub

Private Sub txtBarcode_KeyDown(ByVal KeyCode As MSForms.ReturnInteger, ByVal Shift As Integer)
    If KeyCode = vbKeyReturn Then
        KeyCode = 0
        ApplyBarcode
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub txtModel_AfterUpdate()
    Dim hint As Object
    If mExisting Then Exit Sub
    If Trim$(txtModel.Text) = "" Then Exit Sub
    Set hint = IMS_SuggestFromModel(txtModel.Text)
    FillEmpty hint
End Sub

Private Sub btnSave_Click()
    Dim fields As Object
    Set fields = CollectFields()
    If mExisting Then
        If IMS_UpdateAssetMetadata(fields) Then
            IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Metadata updated for " & fields("Barcode") & ". Assignee and status were left unchanged.", False
        Else
            IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
        End If
    Else
        If IMS_SaveNewAsset(fields) Then
            IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Inward saved for " & fields("Barcode") & ".", False
            ClearForm
        Else
            IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
        End If
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnClear_Click()
    ClearForm
End Sub

Private Sub btnClose_Click()
    Unload Me
End Sub

Private Sub ApplyBarcode()
    Dim code As String
    Dim asset As Object
    Dim hint As Object
    code = IMS_NormalizeBarcode(txtBarcode.Text)
    txtBarcode.Text = code
    If code = "" Then Exit Sub
    If Not IMS_ValidBarcode(code) Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Barcode must be 4 to 64 letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set asset = IMS_GetAsset(code)
    If Not asset Is Nothing Then
        mExisting = True
        FillFromAsset asset
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "This barcode is already on file. Saving updates metadata only. Use Transfer to change the assignee.", False
        Exit Sub
    End If
    mExisting = False
    txtInitialAssignee.Enabled = True
    Set hint = IMS_SuggestFromBarcode(code)
    FillEmpty hint
    If hint.Exists("Model") Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "New barcode. Empty fields were filled from the latest " & IMS_FamilyPrefix(code) & " asset.", False
    Else
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "New barcode. Fill the purchase order before saving.", False
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub FillFromAsset(ByVal asset As Object)
    SetOwnership DictStr(asset, "Ownership")
    cboAssetType.Value = DictStr(asset, "AssetType")
    txtPONumber.Text = DictStr(asset, "PONumber")
    txtManufacturer.Text = DictStr(asset, "Manufacturer")
    txtMfsSerialNo.Text = DictStr(asset, "MfsSerialNo")
    txtMake.Text = DictStr(asset, "Make")
    txtModel.Text = DictStr(asset, "Model")
    txtCapacityRev.Text = DictStr(asset, "Capacity_Rev")
    txtDescription.Text = DictStr(asset, "Description")
    txtArrivalDate.Text = DateOnly(DictStr(asset, "ArrivalDate"))
    txtExpiryDate.Text = DateOnly(DictStr(asset, "ExpiryDate"))
    txtInitialAssignee.Text = DictStr(asset, "CurrentAssigneeID")
    txtInitialAssignee.Enabled = False
End Sub

Private Sub FillEmpty(ByVal hint As Object)
    If hint Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    If Len(Trim$(cboAssetType.Value & "")) = 0 And hint.Exists("AssetType") Then cboAssetType.Value = hint("AssetType")
    If txtManufacturer.Text = "" And hint.Exists("Manufacturer") Then txtManufacturer.Text = hint("Manufacturer")
    If txtMake.Text = "" And hint.Exists("Make") Then txtMake.Text = hint("Make")
    If txtModel.Text = "" And hint.Exists("Model") Then txtModel.Text = hint("Model")
    If txtCapacityRev.Text = "" And hint.Exists("Capacity_Rev") Then txtCapacityRev.Text = hint("Capacity_Rev")
End Sub

Private Function CollectFields() As Object
    Dim d As Object
    Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    d.CompareMode = 1
    d("Barcode") = txtBarcode.Text
    If optAMD.Value Then
        d("Ownership") = "AMD-Specific"
    ElseIf optWipro.Value Then
        d("Ownership") = "Wipro-Specific"
    Else
        d("Ownership") = ""
    End If
    d("AssetType") = cboAssetType.Value
    d("PONumber") = txtPONumber.Text
    d("Manufacturer") = txtManufacturer.Text
    d("MfsSerialNo") = txtMfsSerialNo.Text
    d("Make") = txtMake.Text
    d("Model") = txtModel.Text
    d("Capacity_Rev") = txtCapacityRev.Text
    d("Description") = txtDescription.Text
    d("ArrivalDate") = txtArrivalDate.Text
    d("ExpiryDate") = txtExpiryDate.Text
    d("AssigneeID") = txtInitialAssignee.Text
    Set CollectFields = d
End Function

Private Sub SetOwnership(ByVal value As String)
    optAMD.Value = (value = "AMD-Specific")
    optWipro.Value = (value = "Wipro-Specific")
End Sub

Private Sub ClearForm()
    mExisting = False
    txtBarcode.Text = ""
    optAMD.Value = False
    optWipro.Value = False
    cboAssetType.ListIndex = -1
    txtPONumber.Text = ""
    txtManufacturer.Text = ""
    txtMfsSerialNo.Text = ""
    txtMake.Text = ""
    txtModel.Text = ""
    txtCapacityRev.Text = ""
    txtDescription.Text = ""
    txtArrivalDate.Text = ""
    txtExpiryDate.Text = ""
    txtInitialAssignee.Text = ""
    txtInitialAssignee.Enabled = True
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Scan a barcode. The scanner Enter key looks the tag up.", False
End Sub

Private Function DictStr(ByVal d As Object, ByVal key As String) As String
    If d Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    If Not d.Exists(key) Then Exit Function
    If IsNull(d(key)) Then Exit Function
    DictStr = Trim$(CStr(d(key)))
End Function

Private Function DateOnly(ByVal value As String) As String
    If Len(value) >= 10 Then DateOnly = Left$(value, 10) Else DateOnly = value
End Function

==============================================================================
frmRegister.frm
VBA editor: File > Import File, and choose this .frm.
==============================================================================
Option Explicit

Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()
    lblTitle.Font.Bold = True
    lblTitle.Font.Size = 16
    txtEmpID.MaxLength = 32
    txtEmpName.MaxLength = 120
    txtAccessCode.MaxLength = 32
    txtConfirm.MaxLength = 32
    txtAccessCode.PasswordChar = "*"
    txtConfirm.PasswordChar = "*"
    txtEmail.MaxLength = 120
    IMS_FillCombo cboRequest, IMS_RoleList(), False
    cboRequest.Value = "User"
End Sub

Private Sub btnCreate_Click()
    If IMS_RegisterUser(txtEmpID.Text, txtEmpName.Text, txtEmail.Text, cboRequest.Value, txtAccessCode.Text, txtConfirm.Text) Then
        MsgBox "Request sent for " & UCase$(Trim$(txtEmpID.Text)) & "." & vbCrLf & "A Super Admin must approve it before sign-in.", vbInformation, IMS_APP_NAME
        Unload Me
    Else
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnBack_Click()
    Unload Me
End Sub

==============================================================================
frmTransfer.frm
VBA editor: File > Import File, and choose this .frm.
==============================================================================
Option Explicit

Private mLoaded As Boolean

Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()
    If Not IMS_IsCustodianRole(gRole) Then
        MsgBox "Only inventory custodians can transfer hardware.", vbExclamation, IMS_APP_NAME
        Unload Me
        Exit Sub
    End If
    lblTitle.Font.Bold = True
    lblTitle.Font.Size = 16
    IMS_FillCombo cboStatus, IMS_StatusList(), False
    cboStatus.Value = "Assigned to Engineer"
    txtBarcode.MaxLength = 64
    txtNewEmpID.MaxLength = 32
    ClearView
End Sub

Private Sub UserForm_Activate()
    On Error Resume Next
    txtBarcode.SetFocus
End Sub

Private Sub txtBarcode_KeyDown(ByVal KeyCode As MSForms.ReturnInteger, ByVal Shift As Integer)
    If KeyCode = vbKeyReturn Then
        KeyCode = 0
        LoadAsset
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnTransfer_Click()
    If Not mLoaded Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Scan a barcode first.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If IMS_TransferAsset(txtBarcode.Text, txtNewEmpID.Text, txtRemarks.Text, cboStatus.Value) Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Transfer recorded for " & IMS_NormalizeBarcode(txtBarcode.Text) & ".", False
        LoadAsset
        txtNewEmpID.Text = ""
        txtRemarks.Text = ""
    Else
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnClose_Click()
    Unload Me
End Sub

Private Sub LoadAsset()
    Dim asset As Object
    Dim code As String
    code = IMS_NormalizeBarcode(txtBarcode.Text)
    txtBarcode.Text = code
    Set asset = IMS_GetAsset(code)
    If asset Is Nothing Then
        mLoaded = False
        lblOwnership.Caption = "Ownership:"
        lblType.Caption = "Type / model:"
        lblCurrent.Caption = "Current assignee:"
        lblState.Caption = "Status:"
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Barcode " & code & " is not in the lab database.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    mLoaded = True
    lblOwnership.Caption = "Ownership: " & DictStr(asset, "Ownership")
    lblType.Caption = "Type / model: " & DictStr(asset, "AssetType") & "  " & DictStr(asset, "Model")
    If DictStr(asset, "CurrentAssigneeID") = "" Then
        lblCurrent.Caption = "Current assignee: (in lab cage)"
    Else
        lblCurrent.Caption = "Current assignee: " & DictStr(asset, "CurrentAssigneeID") & "  " & DictStr(asset, "CurrentAssigneeName")
    End If
    lblState.Caption = "Status: " & DictStr(asset, "Status")
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Asset loaded. Choose the new status and record the transfer.", False
End Sub

Private Sub ClearView()
    mLoaded = False
    lblOwnership.Caption = "Ownership:"
    lblType.Caption = "Type / model:"
    lblCurrent.Caption = "Current assignee:"
    lblState.Caption = "Status:"
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Scan a barcode. Enter loads the current assignee.", False
End Sub

Private Function DictStr(ByVal d As Object, ByVal key As String) As String
    If d Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    If Not d.Exists(key) Then Exit Function
    If IsNull(d(key)) Then Exit Function
    DictStr = Trim$(CStr(d(key)))
End Function

==============================================================================
frmUserAdmin.frm
VBA editor: File > Import File, and choose this .frm.
==============================================================================
Option Explicit

Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()
    If Not IMS_IsSuperRole(gRole) Then
        MsgBox "Only a Super Admin can manage accounts.", vbExclamation, IMS_APP_NAME
        Unload Me
        Exit Sub
    End If
    lblTitle.Font.Bold = True
    lblTitle.Font.Size = 16
    IMS_FillCombo cboRole, IMS_RoleList(), False
    lstUsers.ColumnCount = 6
    lstUsers.ColumnWidths = "90 pt;180 pt;110 pt;70 pt;0 pt;110 pt"
    txtAlias.MaxLength = 32
    txtEmail.MaxLength = 120
    txtName.MaxLength = 120
    LoadUsers
End Sub

Private Sub lstUsers_Click()
    If lstUsers.ListIndex < 0 Then Exit Sub
    lblSelected.Caption = CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 0)) & "  " & CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 1)) & "  requested " & CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 5))
    cboRole.Value = CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 2))
    chkActive.Value = (CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 3)) = "Yes" Or CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 3)) = "Pending")
    cboLead.Value = CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 4))
End Sub

Private Sub btnApply_Click()
    Dim empId As String
    If lstUsers.ListIndex < 0 Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Select an account first.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    empId = CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 0))
    If IMS_SetUserRole(empId, cboRole.Value, CBool(chkActive.Value), cboLead.Value) Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Saved " & empId & ".", False
        LoadUsers
    Else
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnReject_Click()
    Dim empId As String
    If lstUsers.ListIndex < 0 Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Select an account first.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    empId = CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 0))
    If IMS_RejectUser(empId) Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Rejected " & empId & ".", False
        LoadUsers
    Else
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnAllow_Click()
    If IMS_AddAllowedPerson(txtAlias.Text, txtEmail.Text, txtName.Text) Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Directory updated for " & UCase$(Trim$(txtAlias.Text)) & ".", False
        txtAlias.Text = ""
        txtEmail.Text = ""
        txtName.Text = ""
    Else
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnClose_Click()
    Unload Me
End Sub

Private Sub LoadUsers()
    Dim data As Variant
    Dim r As Long
    Dim c As Long
    data = IMS_ListUsers()
    lstUsers.Clear
    lstUsers.ColumnCount = 6
    cboLead.Clear
    cboLead.AddItem ""
    If Not IsArray(data) Then Exit Sub
    For r = 1 To UBound(data, 1)
        lstUsers.AddItem CStr(data(r, 1))
        For c = 2 To 6
            lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListCount - 1, c - 1) = CStr(data(r, c))
        Next c
        If CStr(data(r, 3)) = "Lead Admin" And CStr(data(r, 4)) = "Yes" Then
            cboLead.AddItem CStr(data(r, 1))
        End If
    Next r
End Sub
